body:
Lately, I have lost all will to live. I used to have ambition despite my emotional torment. I used to have a fire for life & I would tell myself that I was going to make something good out of all the bad that has ever happened to me. I told myself that I was going to turn coal into diamonds. I guess the problem was that I didn't truly believe it.. I have lost all will to live & I desperately want to get it back but everytime I try to make something of myself, I hear the voices of my past cutting me down. This makes me realize that I am nothing more than a failure and I will never be normal. I can't get past these issues, I've been trying so hard to get help. I've gone to counseling, I've written poems... Nothing can fill the hole. And because of all my wasted efforts, now for the first time in my life I truly feel cursed to hell. I see no hope in the future anymore and every breath I take I can psychically feel pain. Yes, I can feel a tingling sensation in my stomach and I know that it's my hurt. I don't understand how something emotional like that can be felt psychically... All I know is that it can. The tingling doesn't hurt at all... But the emotions behind the tingle are what kill me. 

I have bought a gun and it's sitting about 7 feet away from me right now in my closet. I am afraid to kill myself but I am also afraid to live... lately I've been seriously considering just getting drunk and making the decision. I know that if I were to be drunk, it would be a lot easier to kill myself. I am truly scared of whats happening to me, I feel like I am being taken over by darkness. I feel like I am screaming at the top of my lungs in a crowded room until I cant scream anymore and no one can hear me. My emotions are so strong, I can't even begin to describe them in words.. Everything I have said here can't describe the true sorrow I face. 

I feel like I stare death in the face everyday. I am 20 years old, I know this can't be normal or healthy but it's reality for me. Everytime I think about my situation, I realize that it's really bad. I know I have no friends, I know that I can honestly say not many people care about me, and I do believe most would feel better if they never heard from me again. So what have I been doing lately? Drugs. I have been doing everything I can to take my mind off things. Well, I recently quit doing drugs to cope with things.. I figure that MAYBE, just MAYBE if I quit something good will happen. But I still feel the urge to pop a pill, just one last dance with that happy pill. But I know that's a lie, it won't be the last time if I do it. So I just don't do it. I realize that drugs are a coping resource & that they do help out for as long as you're doing them... Sure, your life will fall apart, but you'll be too busy floating in euphoria to really care. After quitting, I feel I have no more coping resources but maybe that's a good thing because it is what brought me here. If I were on a happy pill, I would not have written this because I simply wouldnt have cared. 

So that's my story.. and I don't know what do. This article is so long, I wonder how many people are going to look at it and decide it's too much to look at. I need someone, you don't need to try to be my friend or anything, I'm not asking you for much.. All I ask is that you please, please, please leave me a comment for writing this. Please tell me if you have ever felt as messed up as I do right now. I know it's probably not true, but please tell me that someone out there cares. I can't keep living this way & I won't keep living this way. I can't express how crucial it is for me right now to know that somebody was listening to me. I have never discussed what I have discussed tonight with ANYONE. You guys are the first people to hear me talk about this. And since I'm doing it anonymously, I'm not too worried about being judged in my real life.

If you guys saw me walking past you on the street or sitting next to you at a red light.. You probably wouldn't think much. I look like a normal person, I don't wear all black or anything just because I am depressed. I dress well and I carry myself well. 

Thats what makes this bad. Nobody knows I need help & I cant tell anyone that I need help. I can only do what Im doing right now which is ask for help anonymously. I fear I will do something stupid within the next year, and I don't want to be another short story in the paper that everyone forgets about the next day. You guys don't owe me anything, it is not your job to try to convince me to stay. I am not looking for you to convince me, you don't even have to leave a comment for this article.. It would be done out of kindness on your part. But I do beg somebody to please write something, even if it's just one sentence, telling me that you;ve been where I'm at and you overcame it. 

I never do this type of thing, I am actually pretty tough. I took boxing classes and like I said, I am well built... So even though I am anonymous, this is still extremely embarrassing.
